exceptions.scope: Development only: the test runner and the linter match globs that live in this repository, never untrusted input
exceptions.removeWhen: A picomatch version outside the affected range is published and older than the release cooldown (minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml, by the registry's publish time), or no installed picomatch matches the range. A fix still inside the cooldown passes with a notice naming the version and when it becomes installable
